out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the delivery door. Observed light coming through the back delivery door.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EHS discussed with PIC repairing the seal of the delivery door. PIC contacted building management to have the delivery door sealed prior the inspection. PIC will send proof of repair to EHS once the repair is completed.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the kitchen walls, floors, baseboards are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS discussed with PIC better cleaning and mopping of the physical facilities to remove food debris and food splatter to prevent harborage of insects. PIC will send proof of cleaning to EHS once it completed.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that ceiling panels in the kitchen are not maintained in good repair in some locations. Observed small gaps in the ceiling panels across the WIC area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS discussed getting the ceiling panels replaced across the WIC area. PIC will email proof of the repair after it is cited.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that ceiling panels in the kitchen are not maintained in good repair in some locations. Observed small gaps in the ceiling panels across the WIC area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS discussed getting the ceiling panels replaced across the WIC area. PIC will email proof of the repair after it is completed.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide a verbal or written policy for preventing the transmission of foodborne disease by an employee who has a disease or a medical condition.
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. PIC trained the staff on the context of Employee Health Policy and obtained their signatures.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the kitchen handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC placed paper towel at the handwashing sink.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. EHS observed packages”Hot Spot” dry chemical pesticides in a storage cabinet below the handwashing sink in the front kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC disposed of the pesticides.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, no signed Employee Illness Reporting Agreements are available for the staff employed at this facility.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information emailed at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. EHS EMAILED THE OWNER THE EMPLOYEE ILLNESS REPORTING AGREEMENT IN BOTH ENGLISH AND SPANISH FOR STAFF TO SIGN BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. EHS observed no written instructions for vomit and diarrhea clean up policy.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS EMAILED A COPY OF THE POLICY TO SHARE WITH STAFF IF AN EVENT OCCURS. PLEASE POST IT IN THE EMPLOYEE RESTROOM.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, after changing tasks or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED OWNERSHIP TO REMIND STAFF TO WASH HANDS AT DESIGNATED HAND SINKS ONLY AT ANY TIME THEY CHANGE TASKS, BEFORE THEY PUT ON GLOVES, AFTER COMING INTO THE FACILITY FROM BEING OUTSIDE, AFTER USING THE RESTROOM, ETC. ENSURE STAFF DEMONSTRATE HAND WASHING AT THE FOLLOW UP. SEE HAND WASHING FACT SHEET EMAILED TO YOU.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. EHS observed no paper towels available in the restroom for customer use and front service counter.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS spoke to PIC about having paper towels available at all hand sinks used by staff and customers. PIC provided paper towels.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. EHS observed no handwashing sign above or near the handwashing sink in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC agreed to repost the handwashing sign by next inspection.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) RAW GROUND BEEF AND RAW SEAFOOD (FOR STAFF) STORED ON A SHELF ABOVE READY TO EAT FOODS INSIDE THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED OWNERSHIP TO STORE RAW ANIMAL FOODS LIKE SEAFOOD AND BEEF ON THE BOTTOM SHELF OF THE REFRIGERATOR AT ALL TIMES. IF THE FOOD IS FOR PERSONAL USE ONLY, ENSURE IT IS STORED IN A CONTAINER LABELED “EMPLOYEE FOOD ONLY” AND STORED ON THE BOTTOM SHELF.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Cooking & Baking Equipment, Clean Every 24 Hours
violations.observation: EHS observed muffins pans, bread pans, loaf pans, sheet pans, etc throughout the kitchen area with excessive carbon build up.
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking and baking equipment shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. EHS spoke to PIC about washing rinsing and sanitizing cooking equipment, PIC agreed to clean all trays next inspection.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: EHS observed “Hot Shot” and “PIC” dry chemical pesticides in a storage cabinet below the handwashing sink in the front kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC disposed of the pesticides. Ensure continued correction and licensed pest control before the follow up.

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. EHS observed “Gorilla Glue” liquid adhesive being stored above clean equipment and dishes. EHS observed cleaning spray bottles for Chlorox, Method brand cleaner, etc with food at the front counter.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. EHS spoke to PIC about storage of toxic materials, PIC moved chemicals away from clean equipment and food. Ensure continued correction before the follow up. GRACE'S PASTRIES (Inspection Date: 01/09/2025) Page 2 of 5

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. EHS observed working containers (spray bottles) of chemicals without common name labels of contents, i.e bleach, sanitizer, detergent
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EHS spoke to PIC about labeling working containers of spray bottles of chemicals. EHS will ensure continued correction at the follow up.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: EHS observed containers of activated charcoal, personal vitamins and medicines being stored with food that is being sold from the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC removed all personal care items so that it was being stored away from the food being sold. EHS REMINDED THE OWNER TO CREATE ONE DESIGNATED LOCATION (CABINET OR EMPLOYEE RESTROOM) FOR STORAGE OF ALL PERSONAL ITEMS. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO OBTAIN A DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER DESIGNED TO MEASURE BOTH HOT AND COLD FOODS. THE OWNER IS REQUIRED TO TAKE TEMPERATURES OF FOODS BEING BOUGHT AT RESTAURANT DEPOT AND FOODS THAT ARE BEING BAKED/COOKED SUCH AS BAKED GOODS THAT CONTAIN MEAT, CHEESE, CREAM CHEESE, AND COOKED VEGETABLES TO ENSURE PROPER TEMPERATURES. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. OWNER WILL ORDER THE DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER TODAY.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. EHS observed oil, sugar, water, and flour being stored on the floor of kitchen area near the stand mixer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS spoke to PIC about acquiring storage racks or dunnage racks before the follow up inspection as bread racks are not acceptable.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. EHS observed PIC with jewelry on hands while preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. EHS spoke to PIC about having to remove jewelry before handling food OR wear gloves at all times if the jewelry can not be removed. Ensure correction before the follow up.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. EHS observed employee in the kitchen handling food without a hair restraint.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. Employee put on a hair restraint. EHS spoke to PIC that employees are required to wear hair restraints if they cannot tie their hair back.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for BAKING SODA are being reused for the storage of other foods like cinnamon and sugar.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED OWNERSHIP TO PROVIDE ONLY NSF APPROVED FOOD CONTAINERS DESIGNED FOR CONTINUOUS WASHING, RINSING, AND SANITIZING TO BE REUSED. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: EHS observed the following in need of cleaning: 1) mixers, 2) shelving, 3) storage racks, 4) sinks, 5) cabinets (interior), 6) insides of drawers, 7) speed racks, 8) exteriors of equipment such as blenders, microwave ovens, etc, 9) interiors of ovens.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS spoke to PIC about cleaning of facility and PIC agreed to clean thoroughly before the follow up.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: EHS observed no covered trash can in the employee restroom in the back of the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. PIC agreed to acquire a covered trash can by next routine inspection GRACE'S PASTRIES (Inspection Date: 01/09/2025) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: EHS observed holes and/or gaps in the ceiling panels where electrical and/or plumbing is located. EHS observed small holes in the wall in the back of the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS spoke to PIC about issue, PIC agreed to fix holes in walls and ceiling panels to prevent entry points for insects/rodents before the follow up.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: EHS observed floors, walls and ceilings of the kitchen area in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC agreed to clean facility by next inspection.

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. EHS observed mop being stored head down in the mop bucket, without being allowed to air dry.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS spoke to PIC about issue, PIC agreed to store mops head up to allow the mop heads to air dry.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: EHS observed no designated area for storage of employees personal items ( jackets, hats, coats and purses).
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. PIC agreed to remove items and to designate a storage area for employees personal items by the follow up inspection.
